tokens.name: color-tp-primary
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons (ActionButton, header “New”), active tabs, focus rings (ring-tp-primary), links, BanterLoader squares. White `color-tp-on-primary` text on it passes 4.9:1.

tokens.name: color-tp-primary-deep
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of every `color-tp-primary` fill (`hover:bg-tp-primary-deep`); emphasis text on light grounds.

tokens.name: color-tp-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `color-tp-primary` and `color-tp-primary-deep` fills.

tokens.name: color-tp-sunshine-300
tokens.usage: Lightest stop of the blue spectrum; soft highlight fills behind illustrations.

tokens.name: color-tp-sunshine-500
tokens.usage: Mid stop of the SunsetStripeBand gradient (55%); decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: color-tp-sunshine-700
tokens.usage: Saturated stop of the SunsetStripeBand gradient (35%) and hero gradients; decorative only.

tokens.name: color-tp-sunshine-800
tokens.usage: Deep spectrum stop; chart/gradient accents. Decorative only.

tokens.name: color-tp-sunshine-900
tokens.usage: Deepest spectrum stop next to primary; gradient accents. Decorative only.

tokens.name: color-tp-yellow-saturated
tokens.usage: Bright aqua stop of the SunsetStripeBand gradient (75%); name kept from SPHERE code. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: color-tp-cream
tokens.usage: Tinted surface for feature panels, cream cards and form panels (ink text on it, 15:1). Name kept from SPHERE code; now a pale blue.

tokens.name: color-tp-cream-light
tokens.usage: Hover fill for secondary buttons (`hover:bg-tp-cream-light`) and soft gradient stops.

tokens.name: color-tp-cream-deeper
tokens.usage: Tag/badge chips (badge-cream) with `color-tp-ink` text.

tokens.name: color-tp-beige-deep
tokens.usage: 1px border of `color-tp-cream` surfaces (cards, form panels, feature tiles).

tokens.name: color-tp-block-5
tokens.usage: Spectrum block, light. Decorative fills only.

tokens.name: color-tp-block-6
tokens.usage: Spectrum block, mid. Decorative fills only.

tokens.name: color-tp-block-7
tokens.usage: Spectrum block, deep. Decorative fills only.

tokens.name: color-tp-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `color-tp-canvas`, `color-tp-surface` and `color-tp-cream` (≥14:1).

tokens.name: color-tp-ink-tint
tokens.usage: Slightly softer headline text, hero subtitles.

tokens.name: color-tp-charcoal
tokens.usage: Body emphasis text.

tokens.name: color-tp-slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text: nav links, menu items (8.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: color-tp-steel
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: captions, metadata, inactive tabs (5.2:1 on surface).

tokens.name: color-tp-stone
tokens.usage: Muted labels at 14px+; 3.5:1 on canvas — avoid for small body text.

tokens.name: color-tp-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text and icons only (2.4:1 on canvas — fails for text that must be read; kept from source).

tokens.name: color-tp-hairline
tokens.usage: Default 1px borders of cards, header bottom, dropdowns (`border-tp-hairline`).

tokens.name: color-tp-hairline-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers and skeleton base.

tokens.name: color-tp-hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger 1px borders: inputs, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: color-tp-canvas
tokens.usage: Card, modal, header and input background.

tokens.name: color-tp-surface
tokens.usage: App page background (AuthenticatedLayout) and hover fill of nav/menu items.

tokens.name: color-tp-surface-cream
tokens.usage: Cream-tinted section background (same value as cream).

tokens.name: color-tp-surface-cream-soft
tokens.usage: Lighter tinted section/card background.

tokens.name: color-tp-surface-code
tokens.usage: Dark code blocks, IDE mockups, dark photographic cards.

tokens.name: color-tp-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on `color-tp-ink` and `color-tp-surface-code` fills.

tokens.name: color-tp-on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on dark fills (code block headers).

tokens.name: color-tp-on-cream
tokens.usage: Text on `color-tp-cream` / `color-tp-footer-cream` (the AppFooter uses it at 60–75% opacity).

tokens.name: color-tp-footer-cream
tokens.usage: AppFooter background, directly under the SunsetStripeBand.

tokens.name: color-tp-input-bg
tokens.usage: Text input and select background.

tokens.name: color-tp-input-border
tokens.usage: Text input and select 1px border; focus switches to `color-tp-primary`.

tokens.name: color-tp-link
tokens.usage: Inline links (PermanentLink, footer links) on canvas — 4.9:1.

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-error
tokens.usage: Error icon/text and danger buttons; top border of error AlertModal. Paired with an icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-error-bg
tokens.usage: BlockAlert/Toast error background. `color-tp-severity-error` text on it is 3.4:1 (kept from SPHERE; below 4.5:1 for small text).

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-error-border
tokens.usage: BlockAlert/Toast error border.

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-warning
tokens.usage: Warning icon/text (amber kept from SPHERE: semantic, not brand). 2.1:1 on its bg — always with MdWarning icon.

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning background.

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-warning-border
tokens.usage: Warning border.

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-info
tokens.usage: Info icon/text. Kept from SPHERE (3.4:1 on its bg); sits close to primary, so always pair with the MdInfo icon.

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info background.

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-info-border
tokens.usage: Info border.

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-success
tokens.usage: Success icon/text, always with MdCheckCircle. 2.2:1 on its bg (kept from SPHERE; fails for small text).

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-success-bg
tokens.usage: Success background.

tokens.name: color-tp-severity-success-border
tokens.usage: Success border.
